userStories.notes: COMPLETED. Generated 11 testing stories (US-55-002 through US-55-012) covering the 6 download_segments issues from user interview plus broader test infrastructure gaps. userStories.title: Add tests for cookie propagation in download_segments ydl_opts
acceptanceCriteria: Add test class TestCookiePropagation in tests/test_stage_download_segments.py verifying _build_ydl_opts includes cookiesfrombrowser key when download config has cookies_from_browser set
Add test that ydl_opts contains cookiefile fallback when cookies_from_browser is not configured but a cookiefile path exists in config
Add test that ydl_opts contains NEITHER cookie key when both cookies_from_browser and cookiefile are absent from config
Add test verifying cookiesfrombrowser value is a list (e.g. ['firefox']) not a bare string, matching yt-dlp Python API requirements
All new tests must be marked @pytest.mark.fast and pass independently
userStories.notes: COMPLETED (pre-implemented). TestCookiePropagation class already exists at tests/test_stage_download_segments.py:2345 with 6 tests covering all criteria: cookiesfrombrowser injection (list format verified), cookiefile fallback from cookies_path, cookiefile fallback from cookie_rotation, no-cookie baseline, Tier 3 override, and retry queue propagation. All 6 tests pass with @pytest.mark.fast.

userStories.title: Add tests for ImpersonateTarget type conversion in _apply_escalation_to_ydl_opts
acceptanceCriteria: Add test class TestImpersonateTargetConversion in tests/test_stage_download_segments.py verifying that _apply_escalation_to_ydl_opts converts the '--impersonate' CLI arg string to a proper object type (not a raw string) in ydl_opts
Add test that the impersonation target client field is lowercased (e.g. 'Chrome-136' becomes 'chrome-136') since yt-dlp available targets are lowercase
Add test that when escalation result contains no '--impersonate' arg, ydl_opts does not have an 'impersonate' key
Add test that a malformed impersonate string (e.g. empty string or missing colon) is handled gracefully without raising an unhandled exception
All new tests must be marked @pytest.mark.fast and pass independently
userStories.notes: Added TestImpersonateTargetConversion class at tests/test_stage_download_segments.py:1438 with 5 tests: (1) test_impersonate_arg_produces_object_not_string - verifies ImpersonateTarget not str, (2) test_client_field_is_lowercased - asserts client/os lowercase, (3) test_no_impersonate_arg_means_no_key - only extractor-args, no impersonate key, (4) test_malformed_impersonate_empty_string_no_crash - empty string graceful, (5) test_malformed_impersonate_no_colon_no_crash - no colon graceful. All 5 pass with @pytest.mark.fast.

userStories.title: Add tests for iterative_match checkpoint serialization of video_file field
acceptanceCriteria: Add test class TestMatchSerializationVideoFile in tests/test_stage_iterative_match.py verifying that serialization of MatchResult objects extracts video_file from match.primary_match.video_segment.source_file (not getattr(match, 'video_file', ''))
Add test that a MatchResult with primary_match.video_segment.source_file='abc123' serializes to a dict with video_file='abc123' (not empty string)
Add test that a MatchResult with no primary_match (None) serializes video_file as empty string without raising AttributeError
Add test that serialized matches can be deserialized via Match.from_dict() and the video_file value survives the round-trip
Add test that the else branch (non-MatchResult simple Match objects) also correctly serializes video_file
All new tests must be marked @pytest.mark.fast and pass independently
userStories.notes: Added TestMatchSerializationVideoFile with 6 tests: MatchResult extracts source_file from primary_match.video_segment, None primary_match returns empty string, round-trip via state.Match.from_dict, simple state.Match else branch, empty source_file handling, else branch round-trip. All @pytest.mark.fast, all pass.

userStories.title: Add tests for network failure pattern matching against Python API exception formats
acceptanceCriteria: Add test class TestNetworkFailurePythonApiPatterns in tests/test_error_classification.py verifying is_network_failure() matches DNS resolution errors in Python exception format: 'Failed to resolve' and 'Errno 11001' (Windows DNS failure)
Add test that is_network_failure() matches ffmpeg exit code patterns: '4294967158' (unsigned) and '-314' (signed) from Python API error output
Add test that classify_error_category() returns 'network' for DNS failures and 'bot_detection' for 403/Sign-in errors, confirming the priority chain is correct
Add test that bot-detection messages ('Sign in to confirm', '403: Forbidden') are NOT classified as network failures by is_network_failure()
All new tests must be marked @pytest.mark.fast and pass independently
userStories.notes: Added TestNetworkFailurePythonApiPatterns class with 17 tests in tests/test_error_classification.py. Tests cover: DNS resolution errors (Failed to resolve, Errno 11001), ffmpeg exit codes (4294967158 unsigned, -314 signed), classify_error_category priority chain (network for DNS, bot_detection for 403/Sign-in), and negative cases (bot-detection NOT classified as network). All @pytest.mark.fast.

userStories.title: Add tests for download_segments bot-detection abort counter behavior
acceptanceCriteria: Add test class TestBotDetectionAbortCounter in tests/test_stage_download_segments.py verifying that consecutive bot-detection errors (403, 'Sign in') increment a shared counter across video IDs
Add test that when bot-detection counter exceeds BOT_DETECTION_ABORT_THRESHOLD (default 10), the download loop aborts early with appropriate logging
Add test that a successful download resets the bot-detection counter to zero
Add test that bot-detection errors do NOT reset the network failure counter (verifying the counter interaction described in Issue 6)
All new tests must be marked @pytest.mark.fast and pass independently
userStories.notes: Added TestBotDetectionAbortCounter class with 6 tests in tests/test_stage_download_segments.py. Tests cover: shared counter across video IDs (403 + Sign-in errors), abort with logging when threshold exceeded, error_categories recording, counter reset on success, and bot-detection errors NOT resetting network failure counter. All @pytest.mark.fast.

userStories.title: Add tests for EscalationManager circuit breaker wiring and tier floor propagation
acceptanceCriteria: Add test class TestCircuitBreakerWiring in tests/test_escalation_manager.py verifying that after set_circuit_breaker() is called, get_escalation_args() returns max-tier args when circuit breaker is open
Add test that set_tier_floor() causes all subsequent get_escalation_args() calls for NEW keywords to start at the floor tier instead of Tier 1
Add test that existing keywords below the tier floor are escalated to floor tier on next get_escalation_args() call
Add test that when circuit_breaker is None (default, never wired), get_escalation_args() returns normal tier-based args without shortcutting
All new tests must be marked @pytest.mark.fast and pass independently
userStories.notes: Added TestCircuitBreakerWiring class with 5 tests: (1) CB open shortcuts to FULL_BYPASS, (2) tier floor new keywords start at floor, (3) existing keywords below floor elevated, (4) no CB means no shortcut, (5) closed CB means no shortcut. All @pytest.mark.fast.

userStories.title: Add download_segments stall detection timeout test coverage
acceptanceCriteria: Add test class TestDownloadStallDetection in tests/test_stage_download_segments.py verifying that the ydl.download() call is wrapped in a timeout mechanism that raises after a configurable duration
Add test that when ydl.download() exceeds the stall timeout, the error is classified as 'timeout' by classify_error_category() and feeds into the retry/escalation logic
Add test that socket_timeout in ydl_opts is set to the configured value (default 30) and is distinct from the stall detection timeout
Add test that a download that completes within the timeout is not interrupted
All new tests must be marked @pytest.mark.fast and pass independently
userStories.notes: COMPLETED. Added TestDownloadStallDetection class with 8 tests in tests/test_stage_download_segments.py: stall timeout wraps ydl.download(), timeout classified as 'timeout' by classify_error_category(), timeout feeds into retry queue, timeout recorded in error_categories stats, socket_timeout set to configured value (default 30), socket_timeout distinct from stall timeout (not in ydl_opts), fast download not interrupted, moderate duration download not interrupted. All @pytest.mark.fast, all 8 pass.

userStories.title: Add error classification coverage for severity multipliers and edge cases
acceptanceCriteria: Add test class TestErrorSeverityClassification in tests/test_error_classification.py verifying classify_error_severity() returns 'high' for quota-exceeded and bot-detection patterns, 'medium' for 429/rate-limit patterns, 'low' for age-gate/login patterns
Add test that SEVERITY_MULTIPLIERS dict maps correctly: low=1.5, medium=2.0, high=3.0
Add test that classify_error_category() returns 'video_specific' for errors that don't match network, bot_detection, or timeout patterns (the fallthrough case)

userStories.notes: Tier: T3 (coverage gap). Source files: src/downloader/error_classification.py:1-193 (ERROR_SEVERITY_PATTERNS, SEVERITY_MULTIPLIERS, classify_error_severity).
